title: lipochaeta succulenta
intro: Lipochaeta succulenta, commonly known as Ma'o hau hele, is a flowering plant native to the island of Kauai in Hawaii. This plant is known for its yellow flowers and succulent leaves, which have been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for various health benefits. Lipochaeta succulenta is said to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as treat skin infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions.
